title: Input-head position
statement: Let a call specification and register-word assignment determine the segments of a virtual input, and let $s$ be a segment index with track position $t$. The input-head position is the track position at segment $0$, shifted by one and converted to a natural number, when $s=0$; when $s\ne0$, it is the length of segment $0$ plus one.
caveat: The snippet does not provide the definitions of segment length or track position, so their precise conventions cannot be stated here.
